title: Clean Dashboard System
license: MIT (original work, created for this project)
use_when: data-heavy products: dashboards, trackers, admin tools, finance apps

layout.structure: fixed left sidebar (240px) + top navbar (64px) + content area with 24px padding
layout.sidebar: nav sections with grouped links, active state = primary color bar
layout.cards: white surface, 1px border color_border, radius, shadow_card, 16px inner padding

components.button_primary: bg color_primary, white text, radius, padding 10px 18px, hover color_primary_hover
components.table: zebra rows color_bg, sticky header, font_size_small
components.state_empty: centered icon + heading (h2) + one-line hint + primary CTA

usability_rules: primary action visible and high-contrast on every screen
navigation state always visible (current section highlighted)
